+from rich._wrap import divide_line
+from rich.cells import cell_len
+
+def test_divide_line():
+    text = "你好世界"
+    width = 1
+    divides = divide_line(text, width, fold=True)
+    print(f"Text: {text}, Width: {width}, Divides: {divides}")
+    
+    # Split text based on divides
+    parts = []
+    last_idx = 0
+    for idx in divides:
+        parts.append(text[last_idx:idx])
+        last_idx = idx
+    parts.append(text[last_idx:])
+    print(f"Parts: {parts}")
+
+    # Each part should have cell_len <= width
+    for part in parts:
+        print(f"Part: {part}, Cell Len: {cell_len(part)}")
+        assert cell_len(part) <= width
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_divide_line()
